recipe_version.title: Cypriot Grilled Halloumi with Lemon-Herb Orzo Salad
recipe_version.description: Thick slabs of halloumi seared in a grill pan until golden and squeaky, served warm over an orzo salad with cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red onion, kalamata olives, mint, parsley, and a lemon-oregano dressing.

ingredients.name: halloumi
ingredients.display_name: 8-oz packages halloumi whose label lists microbial or vegetable rennet

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.note: zest of 1, juice of 2 (about 1/3 cup); a few wedges reserved

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.body: Zest one lemon and juice both (reserve a couple of wedges first). Whisk the juice, zest, oregano, 6 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, and the pepper in a large bowl.

steps.title: Cook the orzo
steps.body: Bring 10 cups water and 2 tsp salt to a boil in a 4-quart pot. Cook the orzo until tender with a slight bite, about 9 minutes. Drain, rinse briefly under the cold tap, and toss with the dressing.

steps.title: Cut the salad
steps.body: While the orzo cooks, dice the cucumber, halve the tomatoes and olives, chop the onion, and chop the mint and parsley (overlap stated).

steps.title: Toss the salad
steps.body: Toss the vegetables, olives, and herbs into the dressed orzo.

steps.title: Sear the halloumi
steps.body: Cut the halloumi into 1/2-inch slabs and pat dry. Preheat a grill pan over medium-high for 3 minutes, brush the slabs with 2 tbsp olive oil, and sear until deep golden with grill marks, about 2 minutes per side.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Pile the orzo salad on plates, lay the hot halloumi on top, and serve with lemon wedges.
